title: Require Recipe Stage Source Topology
forbids: recipe stage collections and first-level stage or family containers outside the positive recipe-stage blueprint topology
why: Recipe stages live in named containers. Collections contain only first-level stage or family containers, and those containers may own only child stage containers, stage authoring, steps, artifacts, visualization, logging, or one shared public.config.ts surface. Nested-stage authoring files are checked generically when present; their closed filesystem scope activates with the physical hierarchy migration.
remediate: Move loose stage files into the owning container, name shared family authoring surfaces public.config.ts, and delete support files that do not have an admitted recipe-stage owner.
message: Recipe stage source must match the positive first-level container and public.config.ts topology.
